about_the_game:
In this wild and colorful graphic adventure, you play as Tofu, a cheeky little college hamster with zero shame and a whole lot of attitude. Dive into an out-of-control college night in the city of Furrol, where the party never sleeps, secrets hide behind every sip of juice, and every animal has their own drama to spill. A story packed with partying and mystery, tons of humor and terrible jokes, but above all… Drug—wait, I mean, SUGAR!

Load up on gummies🍬, juice boxes🧃, and chocolate bars🍫 to experience the true Furrol Experience.

What starts as a night of partying with your campus’s most chaotic ferret, Churro, quickly spirals into a surreal mystery when something weird happens after the first round of juice.
Your mission: figure out what went down and survive the weirdest night of your life.

Get ready for a ride through neon lights, chaotic beats, unforgettable characters, and sooo many sweets. 🍭

🗺️ Dive into the wild side of Furrol

Embrace the chaos, the madness, and the humor of a city that blends the best (and worst) of college life. From graffiti-covered buildings to streets where rules are just a suggestion, Furrol is a love letter to reckless youth and an unhealthy obsession with candy.

Explore a living, detailed city filled with unique areas:

  • Theme bars, underwater nightclubs, secret alleys, and not-so-legal candy shops.

  • Every venue has its own vibe, music, and wild local fauna.

  • Unlock new zones as you progress through the story (or do the right “favors”).

🐾 Chat with all kinds of animals


The soul of the game lies in its characters. Meet and talk to:

  • Bats who are existentialist poets

  • Frogs that live for influencer life.

  • Moles obsessed with conspiracy theories.

  • Brawler penguins and DJ bunnies.

Every conversation could lead to a quest, a clue... or just an absurdly unforgettable moment.

 

 

🔍 Complete quests to uncover the night’s mystery

Your goal is clear (well, kind of): figure out the chaos. But to do that, you’ll need to:

  • Shape Tofu’s personality — are you full chill or full chaos? You decide.

  • Explore each venue with its own unique vibe and look for clues.

  • Interrogate some very questionable witnesses and fulfill their weird requests.

  • And, of course, go totally wild and consume LOTS OF SUGAR.

🎁 Find all the collectibles

Dig deep to unlock:

  • Limited-edition, one-of-a-kind candies.

  • Memories, hidden references, and memes.

  • Secret achievements that reward your curiosity and love for the absurd.

🎮 Conquer every minigame

A college night without doing something stupid? Not on our watch!

  • Games to test your reflexes and rhythm, show off your dance floor skills, or flex your musical talent...

  • Some minigames will change Tofu’s status (yep, tipsy mode included!).

  • Replay them as many times as you want to beat your personal best.

Meet me in Furrol?
11 PM at the plaza — don’t be late! 🍭✨
